title: Unsigned chain evaluation from global cochains
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, X a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and E,I arbitrary integer complexes of sheaves of A-modules. Let C_E be the A-linear global Hom cochain complex with differential d_I f−(−1)ⁿf d_E [def-pur-hom-complex]. For any A-complex U and chain map α:U→C_E, there is a chain map t:constant(U)⊗E→I, for the direct-sum total tensor [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves], whose value on every pure tensor of a sheafification-unit constant w and a section e is α(w)(e), with no sign.

source.place: Tags 0A8X and 0A90, global cochains, composition and tensor-Hom differential.

proof.text: For each r,q, the A-linear map w↦α(w)ᵠ defines a restriction-compatible bilinear pairing. Extend over constant sheafification and the sheaf tensor, using the monoidal sheafification adjunction. The coproduct over r+q=n gives a graded map.

The chain identity for α gives d_I(α(w)(e))=α(dw)(e)+(−1)ʳα(w)(d_E e), exactly the total tensor differential. Equality on constant pure tensors determines each sheaf map and equality on coproduct summands determines the graded map. Thus it is a chain map and has the asserted evaluation formula.

theorem globalHom_chain_evaluation {X : Scheme.{u}} (E I : Complexes A X)
    (U : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) ℤ) (alpha : U ⟶ homComplex A E I) :
    ∃ t : chainEvaluationSource A X U E ⟶ I,
      IsChainEvaluation A E I U alpha t
